def test_arithmetic_drops_info(quantity, operation, expected):
    result = operation(quantity)
    assert_quantity_allclose(result, expected)
    assert "info" not in result.__dict__
    assert result.info.name is None
    assert result.info.meta is None
    assert quantity.info.name == "distance"
    assert quantity.info.meta == {"source": "measurement"}


def test_multiple_ufunc_outputs_drop_info(quantity):
    quotient, remainder = np.divmod(quantity, 2 * u.m)
    assert_quantity_allclose(quotient, [0, 2] * u.one)
    assert_quantity_allclose(remainder, [1, 0] * u.m)
    assert "info" not in quotient.__dict__
    assert "info" not in remainder.__dict__


@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", [lambda q: q[:], lambda q: q.copy(),
                                       lambda q: q.to(u.cm), lambda q: q.si,
                                       lambda q: q.decompose()])
def test_same_quantity_preserves_info(quantity, operation):
    result = operation(quantity)
    assert_quantity_allclose(result, quantity)
    assert result.info.name == quantity.info.name
    assert result.info.description == quantity.info.description
    assert result.info.meta == quantity.info.meta
    assert result.info is not quantity.info


def test_explicit_output_preserves_its_info(quantity):
    out = quantity.copy()
    out.info.name = "output"
    result = np.multiply(quantity, 2, out=out)
    assert result is out
    assert_quantity_allclose(out, [2, 8] * u.m)
    assert out.info.name == "output"

                                       lambda q: q.__itruediv__(u.s)])
def test_inplace_preserves_info(quantity, operation):
    result = operation(quantity)
    assert result is quantity
    assert result.info.name == "distance"
